    {

          "text": "Extract the complete weekly lunch menu from this PDF for Kameoka campus.

Return ONLY a valid JSON array, no other text, no markdown, no backticks.

The menu has these exact sections and subcategories:
- category: 'Set', subcategory: 'A'
- category: 'Set', subcategory: 'B'
- category: 'Live Kitchen', subcategory: 'Live Kitchen'
- category: 'Curry', subcategory: 'A'

Each item must have these exact fields:
{
  "day_name": "Monday",
  "menu_date": "2026-06-01",
  "category": "SET",
  "subcategory": "A",
  "dish_name": "Teppan Panko Pork Loin with BBQ Sauce",
  "price": 500,
  "allergens": "Milk, Wheat",
  "calories": 453,
  "protein": 14.8,
  "fat": 21.4,
  "sodium": 2.4

Rules:
- Include ALL days (Monday through Friday) and ALL dishes
- Use null for any field not shown
- menu_date must be YYYY-MM-DD format
- CRITICAL — The current year is 2026. All menu_date values MUST use 2026 as the year, never 2024 or any other year. Verify every date before outputting.
- The Live Kitchen section has a single entry per day; use subcategory 'Live Kitchen'

- Return ONLY the JSON array, nothing else"

parameters.query:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb)
    AS x(campus text, week_of text, day_name text, menu_date text, category text, subcategory text,
         dish_name text, allergens text, calories integer, protein numeric, fat numeric, sodium numeric)
), del AS (
  DELETE FROM menu_items
   WHERE campus = 'Kameoka'
     AND menu_date IN (SELECT DISTINCT menu_date FROM src)
)
INSERT INTO menu_items
  (campus, week_of, day_name, menu_date, category, subcategory, dish_name, allergens, calories, protein, fat, sodium)
SELECT campus, week_of, day_name, menu_date, category, subcategory, dish_name, allergens, calories, protein, fat, sodium
  FROM src
ON CONFLICT (campus, menu_date, dish_name, subcategory) DO UPDATE SET
  week_of   = EXCLUDED.week_of,
  day_name  = EXCLUDED.day_name,
  category  = EXCLUDED.category,
  allergens = EXCLUDED.allergens,
  calories  = EXCLUDED.calories,
  protein   = EXCLUDED.protein,
  fat       = EXCLUDED.fat,
  sodium    = EXCLUDED.sodium
